metadata.title: AI RMF GOVERN Function — Example Profile

remarks.p: An example profile that scopes the AI RMF 1.0 catalog to a single function. It selects the GOVERN function by glob expression, which resolves to 25 controls: the 6 GOVERN categories and their 19 subcategories.

This example demonstrates selection by matching pattern against a catalog whose control identifiers carry the function name as a prefix, and the as-is merge strategy, which preserves the catalog's group structure so the resolved catalog still presents GOVERN as a function.
